fourPiece.label: 4 件套全队伤害
fourPiece.conditionText: 队伍中任意角色发动[招架支援]或[回避支援]时，持续10秒。

fourPieceEffectTexts.en: When any squad member triggers a Defensive Assist or Evasive Assist, all squad members deal 15% increased DMG, lasting 10s. Passive effects of the same name do not stack.
fourPieceEffectTexts.zh-CN: 队伍中任意角色发动[招架支援]或[回避支援]时，全队角色造成的伤害提升15%，持续10秒，同名被动效果之间不可叠加。
